$comment: THE BOOTH: the commentary voice identity, in one place. Two fixed seats (play-by-play + colour), rendered OFFLINE by scripts/booth/ into pre-recorded clips; nothing is synthesised while the game runs. A 'pair' is one complete booth (both seats, same engine). The stems for a pair live in src/renderer/public/commentary/<pair>/ and its name bank in mods/<mod>/commentary/<pair>/ (real names are mod data). The fictional name pools' bank ships at src/renderer/public/commentary/<pair>/names/. Changing a seat's voice means re-rendering that pair's stems AND name banks. See docs/COMMENTARY-BOOTH.md.

nameCarriers.$comment: Dia2 cannot say a lone word, so every name clip is cut out of a carrier phrase. The carrier sets the inflection.
